source_of_truth: Bundled frozen specs + active contracts; explicit user scope is preserved.
additive_stages: W01-R (Source Reading → Structure → Narrative → Allocation) — between W01 and W02; W00–W18 numbering unchanged; gate `reading-structure`; method is material-agnostic, material-specific vocabulary is declared per run in `profile`
scope_limitations: Geometry qualification is limited to simple final-SVG bar/point/line/interval primitives and explicit linear/log encodings.
No automatic clinical entailment or final RED approval.
P05 is a regression fixture, not a full-source recall certification or a mandatory layout.
Relocation tested locally; cross-OS rendering still requires target-runtime qualification.
Privacy validators verify page/surface evidence completeness; OCR, face and DICOM inspection still require qualified tools or reviewers.
Independent-oracle validation proves agreement with a reviewed inventory, not autonomous clinical truth.

Native beautification MVP supports five deterministic archetypes and up to four Claims per page; ChatGPT Image may supply only a validated non-semantic underlay with a palette/safe-zone fusion theme and is disabled without an explicit manifest.

The W01-R gate verifies that a reading happened and that its claims are traceable and that all material-specific vocabulary was declared. It does NOT verify that the reading was good, the structure correct or the narrative effective: those remain reviewer-assessed and the gate reports them as not assessed.

Portability is evidenced by two materials of different kinds run through the unchanged gate (clinical textbook, technical report). A material that appears to need a method change most likely needs a `profile` field instead.

REG-READ-016 separates the presentation layer from the working layer: the slide surface carries presentation language only, and citation markers, block references, internal ids, editorial labels, elided quotations and commentary on the deck's own structure are working-layer content that belongs in speaker notes and the artifact. The gate checks the declared on_slide_text for these marks; it does not judge whether the wording is clear.

REG-READ-017 requires the derived structure to be rendered: a roadmap page, the question at each part boundary, every narrative node exposed by some page, and a consolidation page. The gate checks their presence and the page/narrative order agreement; it does not judge whether the rendered structure helps the reader.

The W01-R rule set (17 rules, 9 checks) is stable and verified end to end, but is not frozen: three of its four corrected gate defects were the same mistake — a criterion written for one page or check kind applied to all of them. When a rule fails on work that satisfies it, suspect the rule first.

stable_rule_sets.note: Stable, not frozen. Not part of the 178 frozen Module 01-06 rules; frozen_specs_changed remains false.
